title: Dashboard design: hierarchy, grouping and the path of the eye

videos.script: A director opens the dashboard on a Monday morning with one question. Are we growing? {{question}} On this screen, nine tiles are all the same size. A logo, two pies, a gauge, a table, a map. The answer is in the bottom right corner, the last place anybody looks. {{before}} Here is the same information arranged by importance. Three numbers across the top, the most important on the left. The trend beneath them, bigger than anything else. The breakdown beside it, smaller. {{after}} Nothing was added. The difference is size, position and grouping, and the reader feels it before reading a word. {{difference}} This lesson starts from the questions a dashboard answers, and puts them in order on the screen. Then it groups what belongs together, and ends with a test you can run in five seconds. {{plan}}
